rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing
positions.catalyst: SK Hynix's ~$28B Nasdaq ADR debut trades today (7/10, when-issued 'SKHYV') — >7x oversubscribed, the 2nd-largest IPO ever — a loud sentiment endorsement of the AI/HBM-memory supply chain. Semis are digesting a 2-day rebound: MU (+8.9% yesterday) is pulling back -0.8% pre-market, SOXL -3.3%, AVGO -0.9%, MRVL -1.3% — but TSM is the LONE green semi at +0.4% (pre-market $438.78 vs $436.96 close), showing relative strength. TSM reports Q2 on 7/16 (guided $39-40.2B rev, +10% QoQ; 65.5-67.5% GM) and is in its 7/6-15 quiet period, so no company-issued surprises in the next 24h.
positions.driver: On a flat broad tape (S&P +0.03%, Nasdaq -0.18%) with the semi momentum theme 2 days old and rolling over pre-market, chasing 3x SOXL (-3.3%) or extended MU (+8.9% then fading) into a digestion carries violent reversal risk and trips the no-chase rule. TSM is the cleaner, lower-vol expression: the quality AI-foundry leader and picks-and-shovels beneficiary of the exact AI/HBM demand SK Hynix's oversubscribed debut reinforces, showing relative strength (only green semi) rather than an extended gap. Chose 1x single-name over leverage deliberately — low-edge, flat-market day calls for lower-vol + downside protection, and TSM at +0.4% is not chasing. Pre-earnings drift into 7/16 adds a positive lean; quiet period removes 24h binary risk.
positions.risks: Counter-theme risk: if the broad semi rebound fully rolls over (the original AI-valuation-fear washout narrative reasserting), even a relatively-strong TSM gives back with the group. ADR/Taiwan-macro and FX (TWD) headline risk. Pre-earnings positioning can unwind if sentiment sours ahead of 7/16. Low-conviction, low-edge entry (+0.4%), so upside is modest — this is a downside-protected park, not a moonshot. Hard stop at $412.45 (-6%).
